free_tier_limits.correction: The free Hobby plan has published resource-specific limits, including 200 projects, 100 deployments per day, one concurrent build, and usage caps for compute, bandwidth, and other services.

rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published and vary by operation and scope; API responses expose X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers.

cors.correction: Vercel directs integrations to call the REST API only from server-side code to avoid CORS issues and prevent token exposure.

notes: The API is operational and GET /v2/user remains documented. The entry incorrectly treats bearer access-token authentication as apiKey, says published free-plan limits are unknown, and says rate limits are unpublished. Official guidance also resolves browser CORS usage as server-side-only.
